title: JIPMER Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 02 Project Research Scientist Posts
description: The Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies for 02 Project Research Scientist I and II Jobs. Interested and eligible aspirants can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application.
